# Vedic Wisdom — Full Agentic Context & Service Catalog

## Introduction
Vedic Wisdom is a premier advisory platform specializing in traditional Vedic Astrology and 100% Non-Demolition Spatial Vastu consultancy. Established in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, under the leadership of Ravindra Pathak and Sandeep K. Tripathi, the platform serves enterprise clients, factory owners, and individual spiritual seekers across India, the United Arab Emirates, and the GCC region.

## Methodologies & Systems

### 1. Krishnamurti Padhdhati (KP System) & Cuspal Interlinks (CIL)
- Micro-division of 12 zodiac signs into 27 Nakshatras and subsequent Sub-Lords and Sub-Sub Lords.
- Pinpoints event manifestation windows down to specific planetary dasha-bhukti-antara periods.
- Birth Time Rectification (BTR) utilizing ruling planets and cusp coordination.

### 2. 16-Zone Spatial Vastu & Elemental Balancing
- Precise 16 directional zones (N, NNE, NE, ENE, E, ESE, SE, SSE, S, SSW, SW, WSW, W, WNW, NW, NNW) aligned with the Pancha Mahabhutas (Water, Air, Fire, Earth, Space).
- 100% Non-Demolition remedial protocols utilizing metallic energy strips (brass, copper, aluminium, iron, lead), energized cosmic pyramids, and elemental colour frequency balancing.
- On-site Lecher Antenna wavelength bio-resonance diagnostics to detect Hartmann and Curry geopathic stress grids.

### 3. Digital Reports & Automated Dossiers
- Comprehensive Janam Kundli Dossier (50+ pages): In-depth house-by-house analysis, planetary strengths (Shadbala), Vimshottari dasha predictions, and gemstone/faith remedies.
- Industrial & Commercial Vastu Audit Blueprint: Zone-by-zone energy mapping, machinery positioning, heavy load axis alignment, and cashbox direction.
- Vedic Marriage & Compatibility Dossier: 36-Guna matching, Manglik dosha evaluation, KP 7th cusp sub-lord compatibility, and longevity analysis.
- Career & Financial Prosperity Forecast: 2nd, 6th, 10th, and 11th cuspal linkages evaluated for enterprise ventures, job transitions, and wealth preservation.

### 4. Interactive Tools & Computational Panchang
- Accurate Lahiri / Chitrapaksha Ayanamsa birth chart computation.
- Real-time Surya Siddhanta panchang: Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, and Rahu Kaal periods.
- Choghadiya Muhurta table for enterprise deal closures and journey commencement.
- 16-Zone interactive compass dial with common flaws and non-demolition remedies.
